messages:
Taylor (People Ops): Quick update0 we clarified caregiver/parental leave language in the handbook (intermittent leave + STD coordination). Please review and ack if you own manager approvals. Handbook: https://docs.redwoodinc.com/people/handbook/caregiver-leave :page_facing_up:

Taylor (People Ops): Short microlearning (10 mins) published for managers + manager-facing ICs. Completion required by Apr 16. Tracker + LMS link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Care-Tracker

Diego (Recruiting): New manager hires 0 when should onboarding mark this as due? Can we add to the 30-day checklist?

Priya (People Ops): Yes add to 30-day onboarding for new managers; they must complete within 14 days. Recruiting: please flag new manager hires in the tracker at offer close.

Lina (Legal): Reviewed. Minor tweak suggested to examples of "eligible caregiver". Also note: EU acknowledgements must be retained for 3 years.

Taylor (People Ops): Thanks Lina 0 added an "EU" column and accepted the examples. We'll snapshot the handbook once Legal signs off and email the group.

Diego (Recruiting): Contractors 0 do vendor-contracted leads need to take this? Some vendor contracts forbid external training.

Priya (People Ops): Mandatory for W-2 employees and any contractors who make people decisions. If a vendor contract prohibits training, escalate to people-ops@redwood for an exception. We'll add a contractor flag and a "vendor_exception" column in the tracker.

Taylor (People Ops): Admin notes: - Emoji ack on the tracker is fine for quick signoff - Managers: list teams in Col B by Apr 1 - Complete microlearning by Apr 16 - People Ops will import LMS completions on Apr 17 and reconcile.

HR-bot: Reminder scheduled 0 automated manager reminders will run Apr 5 for unconfirmed teams.

Taylor (People Ops): Please do not post medical or PHI in Slack 0 use the secure intake form in the handbook for any documentation. Thanks! :heart:
